title: Name Correction Terms Carried by the Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
Two quantities govern the correction of a misspelled traveller name on a ticket issued under the Air Ticket Fare Brands.

**Name-correction fee.** The fee to correct a misspelled traveller name on an issued ticket.

**Character limit.** The greatest number of characters that may be corrected in a name before a new ticket is required.

| Fare brand | Name-correction fee (USD) | Character limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Basic Economy Lite | 0.00 | 0 |
| Economy Saver | 85.00 | 3 |
| Economy Classic | 65.00 | 3 |
| Economy Flex | 45.00 | 4 |
| Premium Economy Select | 35.00 | 4 |
| Business Saver | 25.00 | 5 |
| Business Flex | 0.00 | 5 |

## Reading the two columns together

The fee and the limit are scheduled independently, and the two ends of the table show it: Basic Economy Lite is scheduled at a fee of 0.00 USD and a limit of 0 characters, while Business Flex is scheduled at a fee of 0.00 USD and a limit of 5 characters. The same fee therefore accompanies the narrowest limit and the widest.

The limit takes three values above zero: 3 characters on Economy Saver and Economy Classic, 4 on Economy Flex and Premium Economy Select, and 5 on the two Business brands. The fee falls steadily from 85.00 USD to 0.00 USD.

## Hypothetical boundary

A spelling that differs from the identity document in exactly 4 characters sits at the limit scheduled for Economy Flex and Premium Economy Select, and within the limit of 5 scheduled for the two Business brands; it exceeds the limit of 3 scheduled for Economy Saver and Economy Classic. A difference of 5 characters sits at the limit only on the two Business brands.
